title: LUAD virtual tissue rulebook
summary: Machine-readable form of MANUAL.md. Declares what each cell type may do, which conditions gate each action, which of those conditions LUAD3 actually measures, and how a decision is posed to a TypeSafe Jev System One model. This file is read by the simulation engine. It is never sent to Jev: the engine projects a small per-decision `state` from it (see jev.state_projection).

sample.generalisation_warning: n = 1. Every D-LUAD3 value describes this section. None is an estimate of LUAD as a disease.

evidence_classes.D-LUAD3: Measured in this specimen. Strongest evidence for initialising the simulation, weakest for any general biological claim.
evidence_classes.H-NSCLC: Human NSCLC literature; transfer conditional on histology.
evidence_classes.X-TISSUE: Another tumour, tissue or experimental setting; mechanism transferred.
evidence_classes.METHOD: Methods paper or official technical documentation.
evidence_classes.SIM: Explicit simulation design choice. Must never be presented as an observation.

measurability_levels.observable: All required components are on the panel and detectable in the relevant cell type.
measurability_levels.partially_observable: Some required components are on the panel.
measurability_levels.assumed_only: No required component is on the panel. Usable only inside a named assumed_competence_profile.
measurability_levels.unobservable_by_design: Requires protein, V(D)J, flux, or time. No Xenium re-analysis can supply it.

split_correction.consequence: SPLIT rescales magnitudes but does not clear spillover-positive cells; UCell ranks within the cell, so spillover still contributes.

detection_depth.note: Three correct values circulate in the delivery. The third is the covariate that governs score interpretation.

panel.gene_evidence_layer_policy: Gene evidence is read from purified_raw, the layer UCell ranked, so that a rule and a signature never disagree about whether a transcript exists. Seven genes are present in raw_counts and effectively absent from purified_raw; a rule may read raw_counts for one of them only by naming the gene and the layer explicitly in its conditions.

layer_sensitive_genes._note: SPLIT removes >99% of the detections of these genes. 292 of 302 genes are unaffected (detection ratio > 0.95). Three of the seven are MHC genes, which is why the antigen-presentation axis is weaker than raw_counts suggests.

signatures_affected_by_layer._note: Nominal panel coverage overstates these six signatures. The other fourteen are unaffected.

annotation.policy_detail: Neither column is a superset of the other. cell_type_fine resolves plasma cells, CAF and proliferating tumour; first_type resolves DC, myeloid, mast/NK and Undefined. A cell carries both labels. Rules act on the intersection of the candidate repertoires unless an identity_scenario is declared.
annotation.populations_with_no_label_policy: Instantiate as not_annotated with the generic maintenance/damage repertoire only. Absence of a label is not absence from the tissue.

vocabulary_mismatch.consequence: Exact-string agreement of 34.85% is not a disagreement rate. A plasma cell CANNOT be concordant, because first_type has no Plasma_cell category at all; the same holds for CAF, Fibroblast and Tumor_proliferating. Compare at lineage level first, and reserve 'conflict' for cells whose lineages actually differ.

agreement_levels.concordant_exact: both columns give the same label
agreement_levels.concordant_lineage: labels differ but map to the same lineage; usually a vocabulary granularity difference, not a disagreement
agreement_levels.conflict: the two columns assign different lineages

identity_conflict_policies.require_all_candidates_in_lineage: Every candidate label must map to a lineage the rule accepts. This is engine constraint H15 applied strictly, and it is the default for any rule whose action is irreversible or damaging.
identity_conflict_policies.allow_any_candidate_match: One matching candidate suffices. The state still carries identity_agreement, so the model can weigh the uncertainty. Use only for reversible, non-damaging actions.

contact_model.source: cell_boundaries.csv, 150055 polygons, <=13 vertices each, obsm['spatial'] frame

tiling.consequence: The tissue is a near-complete tiling. There is no free space: a cell cannot move without displacing another, and a free-membrane budget is not a meaningful variable.

centroid_rule_is_forbidden.bias: size-dependent and bidirectional: under-counts contacts of large cells (CAF median 227 um2) by ~2x, over-counts among small dense cells (B_cell 43.4 um2) by up to 1.8x
centroid_rule_is_forbidden.policy: A centroid threshold may not be used as a contact test.

neighbourhood_30um.policy: Separate field from contacts. Never interchangeable.

occluded_neighbours.policy: Instantiate as occluded_neighbour agents: they occupy space, block movement and can receive imposed damage, but have no identity, state or repertoire. Deleting them makes the tissue porous in a biased way.

limits: 2-D section: contacts out of the imaging plane are invisible.
Contact area in 3-D is unknown; interface lengths are 2-D perimeters.
Contact is adjacency, not synapse formation, and never implies recognition.

migrate.label: Migrate by displacing a contact partner
migrate.note: Geometry is measured; migration rate is uncalibrated.

degranulate.label: Deliver a cytotoxic pulse to a contacted target
forbidden_evidence_substitutions: GOBP_T_CELL_MEDIATED_CYTOTOXICITY as effector competence: 8 of 60 genes on panel, 6 of them APC- or target-side (CD1C, CD1E, FCGR2B, HLA-A, NECTIN2, PVR); median 0.124 in CD8 vs 0.076 in Tumor
GZMB detection as competence: 3.1% of CD8 cells
PRF1 detection as competence: 7.4% of CD8 cells and 16.1% of Tumor cells

antigen_presentation_mhci.label: Present peptide on MHC-I
missing: HLA-A is layer-sensitive: 62.8% in raw_counts, 0.38% in purified_raw
antigen_presentation_mhci.note: No MHC-I component survives in the scoring layer. The axis exists only inside a declared assumed_competence_profile.

antigen_presentation_mhcii.label: Present peptide on MHC-II
antigen_presentation_mhcii.note: CD74 (95.9% in macrophages, layer-stable) is the invariant chain, a marker of the MHC-II pathway rather than MHC-II itself. Peptide identity remains unknown. This is weaker evidence than v0 of this rulebook claimed.
missing: HLA-DPB1 and HLA-DQB2 are layer-sensitive: 57.3% and 17.3% in raw_counts, 0.33% and 0.06% in purified_raw

regulate_costimulation.label: Reduce the costimulation available at a contacted interface
regulate_costimulation.note: Inert in LUAD3: no Treg label exists and FOXP3 is detected in 4.1% of CD4 cells, which cannot call Tregs per cell. The capability exists so a declared Treg scenario has somewhere to attach.

receive_checkpoint_inhibition.label: Receive PD-1 / CTLA-4 inhibitory input
receive_checkpoint_inhibition.note: PDCD1 is detected in 0.6% of CD8 cells and 0.3% of all cells. At single-cell level this axis is unmeasured; it exists only inside the checkpoint_blockade perturbation.

secrete_immunoglobulin.label: Secrete clone-defined immunoglobulin
secrete_immunoglobulin.note: Antibody quantity establishes no antitumour activity without antigen, affinity and an effector mechanism. No clonal state exists.

phagocytose.label: Phagocytose or efferocytose
forbidden_evidence_substitutions: GOBP_PHAGOCYTOSIS as engulfment activity: its panel genes (MARCO, MSR1, ITGAM, ITGAX, PECAM1, PTPRC) are myeloid identity

deposit_matrix.label: Deposit or remodel extracellular matrix
deposit_matrix.note: No matrix-architecture channel was measured. Density and orientation are SIM.

secrete_vegfa.label: Secrete VEGFA
secrete_vegfa.note: VEGFA detected in 52.0% of tumour cells; KDR in 23.9% of endothelial cells. The only near-complete vascular edge.

proliferate.label: Progress the cell cycle and divide
forbidden_evidence_substitutions: GOBP_MITOTIC_CELL_CYCLE as proliferative state: 18 of 959 genes on panel (1.9% coverage), and Tumor_proliferating scores LOWER than Tumor (0.207 vs 0.223)
proliferate.note: Proliferation is a timed engine state machine seeded with low confidence, never score-driven.

barrier_function.label: Maintain vascular barrier and regulate adhesion
barrier_function.note: No HEV evidence: PNAd/MECA-79 is a glycan and unmeasurable; SELP detected in 6.1% of endothelial cells.

die.label: Enter a death state
die.note: Nothing in the object flags dying cells. Dead cells and debris are under-segmented by construction, so recovered frequencies cannot estimate death rates.

notes: Genotype (EGFR/KRAS/STK11/KEAP1) is unknown and must stay unknown outside a declared perturbation.
98.5% of tumour cells touch another tumour cell; nests are closed.
The label rests on UBE2C (14.6% vs 4.2% in Tumor) and MKI67 (3.3% vs 1.4%), both sparse.
It does NOT have a higher mitotic-cell-cycle UCell score than Tumor.
The tumour-contacting population: 59.8% touch a tumour cell, median polygon gap 0.1 um.
Largest cells in the section; the centroid rule under-counted their contacts by ~2x.
Lowest detection depth in the section; its low scores are partly a depth artefact, not quiescence.
Germinal-centre module is DISABLED: AICDA, BCL6, CR2 and FCER2 are all not_assayed and no clonal state exists.
CXCL13 in 50.6% of B cells is the inverse of the canonical Tfh/stromal pattern and must be verified before use.
91.6% touch another B cell; 67.1% of a B cell's interface is B-B.
Absent from first_type entirely.
BAFF/APRIL survival edges are unusable: TNFSF13 and TNFSF13B are not_assayed.
High ER-stress score is the secretory UPR, not terminal damage.
Exhaustion axis unavailable: TOX and HAVCR2 are not_assayed.
1.38% touch a tumour cell section-wide; the degranulation rule is ineligible for ~99% of them at initialisation.
No Treg label exists and FOXP3 is detected in 4.1% of CD4 cells. Treg-specific rules are DISABLED; a Treg scenario may be declared but not inferred.
The connector population: 48.3% touch a CD8 T cell, 40.2% a CD4 T cell, 25.1% a B cell, 13.8% a tumour cell.
The antigen-presentation circuits it supports are the most spatially eligible in this section.
Lymphatic subtype is not separated. No HEV evidence.
bv_HH_60 / bv_HH_100 / bv_peri_HH in the object are B-cell LISA flags, NOT a vessel mask.
For populations the annotation does not resolve. Generic maintenance and damage handling only.
Segmented but QC-dropped. Occupies space, blocks movement, can receive imposed damage. No identity, no state, no repertoire, no Jev call.

interactions._policy: A rule whose required components include a not_assayed gene resolves to unknown, not false, and is withheld unless an assumed_competence_profile is active.

_summary.note: Counted against purified_raw, the layer the scores use. Against raw_counts the count would be 3, adding C08.

C08.caveat: complete in raw_counts; HLA-DPB1 and HLA-DQB2 are effectively absent from purified_raw, so only CD74, CD4 and CD3E survive in the scoring layer

C24.caveat: transcript does not demonstrate mature IL-1b processing and release

C26.caveat: TGFB1 RNA does not measure activation of latent TGFb

contact_behavior.description: What the cell does at one of its existing interfaces this step.

migration.description: Which contact partner, if any, the cell displaces. The tissue is fully packed.

secretion.description: Qualitative compatibility of a secretion programme with the stated context. Independent questions may share one request.

stress_adaptation.description: Degree of adaptive response to a declared perturbation field.

cycle.description: Whether the context is permissive for cycle progression. The cycle itself is a timed engine state machine.

differentiation.description: Slow state transitions with history and lineage constraints. Disabled by default.

survival.description: Engine-controlled. Jev is never asked whether a cell dies.

transfer_limitations: No cited study estimates a per-cell LUAD degranulation rate.
A simulation producing frequent CD8-mediated killing is not reproducing this section.

notes: C08 is complete in raw_counts but layer-dependent in purified_raw: HLA-DPB1 and HLA-DQB2 are effectively deleted by the SPLIT correction. The gate therefore rests on CD74, the invariant chain, and the state records that MHC-II itself is unmeasured in the scoring layer.
This remains the most spatially eligible circuit in the section, which is why it is worth modelling despite the weaker molecular evidence.
C11 is fully on panel. Encode as a contact mechanism, never as a diffusible toxin.
No Treg label exists in this section, so this is not a Treg rule.
C01 is fully on panel, but CXCL13 detection in this section is highest in B cells themselves, which inverts the canonical source and must be verified.
Inside a follicle the neighbourhood is ~70% B cells, so a diffusible field is effectively uniform and provides no gradient to follow.
This is the circuit that is actually eligible at scale in this section, and the mechanism behind the measured immune exclusion.
No matrix-architecture channel was measured. Density and orientation are SIM variables the engine owns.
C28 is the only near-complete vascular edge. FLT1 is not_assayed, so the modulating arm of the axis is missing.
Angiogenic signalling does not instantly create perfusion. A sprout extends geometry only; whether the new segment carries oxygen is a separate engine decision.
The tissue is fully tiled, so a sprout must displace existing cells.
pO2 was never measured. The oxygen field is entirely SIM and must be labelled dimensionless, never nM or mmHg.
Distance to the nearest endothelial cell is a geometric proxy and must not be renamed oxygen_level.
Glycolysis and respiration coexist in human lung tumours; do not implement a universal glycolytic switch.
Jev is asked whether the CONTEXT is permissive, never whether the cell divides. Division is a timed engine state machine.
Division requires displacing a neighbour, because the tissue is fully packed.

section.note: No death state is observed anywhere in LUAD3. Every apoptotic target is engine-created, so this rule is ineligible at t=0 by construction.

notes: One apoptotic body may be consumed once per update by one phagocyte.
Antibody specificity is unknown: no V(D)J data. Quantity establishes no antitumour activity.

The gate accepts lineage-level agreement because first_type has no Plasma_cell category: a plasma cell can never be exact-concordant. Requiring exact agreement froze the entire plasma compartment, which was a vocabulary artefact, not biology.

rules.disabled_reason: No Treg label exists in this section and FOXP3 is detected in 4.1% of CD4 cells, which cannot call Tregs per cell. Enable only inside a declared identity_scenario.

perturbations._policy: Every perturbation is SIM. It declares state variables the engine owns, capabilities it unlocks, and what LUAD3 can and cannot show about it. A run under any perturbation is reportable separately and never comparable to a baseline run without labelling the difference as scenario-driven.

hypoxia.label: Hypoxia

field.oxygen.seed: monotone decreasing function of distance to the nearest Endothelial cell, which is measured; the mapping itself is SIM
field.oxygen.note: A segmented vessel does not establish perfusion. pO2 was never measured.

hypoxia.reporting_requirement: Any claim about hypoxia in a run must state that the oxygen field is a scenario construct with no measured counterpart in LUAD3.

angiogenesis.label: Angiogenesis

field.vegfa.seed: emission from VEGFA-detected cells, diffused on the contact graph

constraints: Endothelial proliferation does not instantly create a perfused vessel.
A sprout must displace existing cells; the tissue has no void.
Immune influx requires an explicit external reservoir and parameterised entry rate, which this rulebook does not supply.
angiogenesis.reporting_requirement: A run may show vascular geometry changing. It may not report perfusion or oxygen delivery as an outcome unless the perfusion model is separately declared.

resistance_mutation.label: Treatment-resistance mutation

available: note: these are EXPRESSION, and expression of EGFR does not establish an EGFR mutation

constraints: LUAD3 has no genotype metadata. scenario.genotype is a declaration, never an inference.
A transcript signature cannot establish a mutation. Do not read NRF2-target expression as KEAP1 loss.
Genotype changes dependencies; it does not change lineage or repertoire.
resistance_mutation.reporting_requirement: Every figure from a resistance run must name the declared genotype and state that it was assigned, not measured.

checkpoint_blockade.label: Checkpoint blockade (anti-PD-1 / anti-PD-L1)

not_available: PDCD1 at usable rates: 0.6% of CD8 cells, 0.3% of all cells

constraints: This axis is entirely a declared scenario. Setting cell.pd1_state is an assignment, not an observation.

Because CD8-tumour contact occurs in 1.38% of CD8 cells, relieving inhibition changes very few cells. A blockade run that produces large tumour killing is reporting the migration model, not the checkpoint model.
checkpoint_blockade.reporting_requirement: State the assumed PD-1 prevalence explicitly, since the data supply none.

inflammation.label: Inflammation / cytokine surge

field.ifng.note: IFNG is not on the panel at all. Nothing in this dataset identifies an IFNg source.

available: TNF, IL1B, IL6, CXCL9, CCL22, CXCL5 as LIGAND transcripts
not_available: note: every receptor for every cytokine in this perturbation is not_assayed, so recipient competence is assumed throughout

constraints: IL1B transcript does not demonstrate mature IL-1b processing and release.
TNF must not always trigger apoptosis.
LUAD alone establishes no pathogen. Keep scenario.pathogen_enabled false unless explicitly declared; endogenous injury generates DAMPs without infection.
A generic 'inflammation' field is acceptable for a demonstration only if its composite nature is explicit.
inflammation.reporting_requirement: Any inflammation run must be labelled as operating under an assumed_competence_profile, because no cytokine receptor in it is measured.

none.description: Default. Rules requiring not_assayed components stay ineligible.

canonical_lineage_receptors_v1.description: Assume canonical lineage receptor expression to explore circuit behaviour. Every decision made under this profile is tagged.
canonical_lineage_receptors_v1.rationale: The panel lacks receptor probes for 31 of 34 interaction edges.
canonical_lineage_receptors_v1.propagation: Every decision log entry carries profile_id and assumption_count.
canonical_lineage_receptors_v1.must_not: Be reported as an observation, or compared against a profile-free run without labelling the difference as assumption-driven.

engine_constraints.constraint: Dead or removed cells do not choose active behaviours.
An action must belong to the authorised identity/state repertoire.
Conventional T cytotoxicity requires contact, a target and cognate recognition.
Contact is the polygon graph, never inferred from arbitrary proximity.
Division requires a completed cycle, resources, a displaceable neighbour and a competent identity.
Cells and mediators require recorded origins.
Multicomponent receptors and ligands need the relevant mechanism; distinguish incompatibility from missing measurement.
Irreversible death commitment overrides behaviour selection. Jev cannot reverse an executed terminal event.
State changes preserve identity and history unless an authorised transition applies.
Use a common tissue snapshot and resolve incompatible events in the engine.
Resources, concentrations and counts cannot be negative; clipping alone must not hide instability.
Missing information cannot become an observed fact.
A raw UCell value may not appear in any threshold, rate or magnitude. Only percentile_within_type or depth_residual may.
engine_constraints.basis: D-LUAD3: rho up to 0.81 with detection depth

engine_constraints.constraint: A signature flagged identity_confounded or low_coverage may not be the sole evidence for a capability gate.
engine_constraints.basis: D-LUAD3: no signature has both adequate coverage and no identity confound

engine_constraints.constraint: Identity conflicts propagate. A cell with agreement=conflict may act only in the intersection of its candidate repertoires unless an identity_scenario is declared.
SUPERSEDED by H04. Formerly: membrane contact may never be true from this dataset.
A rule requiring a not_assayed component is ineligible unless an assumed_competence_profile is active, and every decision made under one is tagged.
The tissue is a near-complete tiling. Movement and division must displace, never occupy void.
The 16,591 segmented cells absent from the AnnData are instantiated as occluded_neighbour: they occupy space and receive imposed damage, but have no identity, state, repertoire or Jev call.
engine_constraints.basis: D-LUAD3: 7.5% of all contacts, 28.2% of cells affected, biased by cell type

engine_constraints.constraint: Jev is never asked whether a cell dies, divides, or what its identity is. It is asked to rank admissible behaviours that code has already validated.
A Jev option-probability is not an event rate. It may not be converted to a per-step hazard without an independently validated calibration.

jev.model_pinning: Record the returned `model` identifier with every decision. Use a pinned version for any defined experiment; jev-latest can change.

documented_limits.pricing: one credit per 1000 input tokens; output tokens free

choice.criteria_shape: object mapping option key to description
choice.semantics: choice is the highest-probability option; probabilities sum to 1; confidence measures concentration of the distribution, not biological correctness

score.semantics: score is the probability-weighted mean level index, an ordered rubric position, never a concentration or a rate

noul.criteria_shape: optional object with true and false descriptions
noul.semantics: noul is P(yes); there is no separate confidence because a two-outcome distribution is fully described by one number; a value near 0.5 does not mean intermediate biological intensity

state_projection.policy: This rulebook is NEVER sent to Jev. The engine builds a small `state` object per decision from the cell record, the rule's required_conditions and the measured context. The rulebook supplies the vocabulary, not the payload.
always_include: cell.region (candidate, core, tls_stage with its evidence caveat, distance to tumour core)
contacts: partner identity candidates, interface_um, gap_um, ordered by interface
include_when_relevant: signature percentiles for the signatures the rule's modulators name, each with its coverage_flag
genes_detected restricted to the genes the rule names, with spillover flags
neighbourhood_30um counts, only for a soluble-signalling question
active perturbation fields and their dimensionless values
never_include: raw UCell values without their percentile and coverage_flag
any field whose measurability is unobservable_by_design presented as observed
literature citations, rule text, or this rulebook
state_projection.excluded_actions_rationale: Every action removed from the candidate set is listed with its reason, so a reviewer can tell whether an action was judged implausible or never offered. Changing the candidate set changes Choice probabilities even when biological state is identical.

call_policy.when_to_call: Only for cells whose admissible set has more than one option after the engine has checked eligibility. Quiescent cells retain state and cost nothing.

measured_load_patch_LUAD3_B26.note: 866 is an upper bound on cells with a non-trivial contact decision; the actual per-tick call count is lower because most heterotypic interfaces have no eligible rule.

call_policy.batching: Independent questions for one cell share one request. Their answers do not condition on each other; when a second judgement needs the first answer, use a sequential step or an explicitly stated hypothetical premise.
call_policy.concurrency_guidance: At 70-500 ms per request, 1,000 cells at 32-way concurrency is roughly 3-16 s per tick. Gate calls by eligibility before scaling concurrency.
call_policy.failure_policy: An API failure triggers a declared fallback: a deterministic admissible policy or maintenance. It must not silently erase a damage event or freeze the biological clock.
call_policy.validation: Check that returned probability keys match the submitted options, that values lie in [0,1] and sum to approximately 1, and that the returned model identifier is recorded.

audit_record.separability: Runs whose decisions were made under identity conflict, under an assumed_competence_profile, or under any perturbation must be reportable separately from a baseline run.

consistency: No CD8 attack without contact and declared recognition.
A candidate TLS with insufficient markers remains indeterminate.

independent_axis.description: The contact graph comes from segmentation, not from the annotation or the TLS pipeline, so reproducing it is a genuine test.

circularity_traps: Do not validate TLS structure against B-cell enrichment: the candidate cores ARE the first_type == B_cell mask.
Do not validate Tumor_proliferating against the mitotic-cell-cycle score: the label was defined from cycle genes, and the test fails anyway.
Do not validate against the 30 um neighbourhood, which is a derived quantity with no independent status.
validation_requirements.depth_matched_null: Before reporting any spatial or regional difference in a signature, repeat the comparison after matching cells on detection-depth decile within cell type.
validation_requirements.temporal_prediction: A single cross-sectional section supplies no ground-truth next state. Hiding part of the section tests spatial interpolation, not temporal prediction.

open_parameters.needed: protein or secretion assay; most receptors are not_assayed
live tumour slices or repeated imaging
a death marker; dead cells are under-segmented by construction

open_parameters.parameter: TLS maturity as a per-cell state

open_parameters.needed: defined outcomes, horizons and independent calibration
